title: St. Philip's Church (Charleston, South Carolina)
scope: The standing St. Philip’s Church in Charleston, including its nave, apsidal east end, front and side porticoes, and projecting steeple.
limitations: The standing church, porticoes and steeple. Adjacent Good Shepherd Chapel, churchyard and interior lie outside scope.
The steeple uses the mapped height, and intermediate heights and ornament are estimated.
